name: @fastify/deepmerge
notes: CommonJS entry point with bundled .d.ts. Default import works from ESM via Node interop. Org-owned by the Fastify project.

build_vs_buy.effort: 1-2 weeks for a basic merge; months for hardened edge cases
build_vs_buy.rationale: The merge API is simple; the semantics are not. Zero-dependency packages already cover it, so a DIY implementation buys little beyond the first week.
